cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've fixed the tap. We'll do this properly: you turn it on, then I'll start the washing-up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time your fix sprayed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why I'm supervising this test with a raincoat. You can wear it, and choose how far to open the tap.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You hold a bucket under that joint. Then I'll turn it on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the controlled test I had in mind. Choose the bucket; I'll hold it. Run the water before we put any dishes underneath. Tell me when you're ready.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims a proper repair plan; A3 gives B protective and flow control; A5 accepts B bucket assignment as the planned test while waiting for B to operate.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 prior spray causes A3 raincoat; B4 bucket condition causes A5 taking the bucket and deferring washing-up until B test.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers a practical way to cooperate rather than another objection, and A5 accepts the less authoritative physical role.

heightening.evidence: A5 supposed supervisor now waits holding B chosen bucket, but still gets someone else to initiate the uncertain fix.

specificity.evidence: A1 tap and washing-up and B4 joint/bucket establish consistent test mechanics.
